core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rabitah corresponds to the Arabic form رَابِطَة and is glossed in this record as “Bond, tie.” The record associates the form with root ر ب ط (r-b-ṭ). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rabitah corresponds to the Arabic form رَابِطَة (Arabic root ر ب ط (r-b-ṭ); رَابِطَة (Rābiṭa)). Its core sense is rabitah; bond, tie. Rabitah is Arabic رَابِطَة (Rābiṭa) 'bond, tie', from the root ر ب ط (r-b-ṭ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave ربيتة (a non-standard form). The source gloss 'Graceful, Beautiful' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
